meta.description: Daily curated Claude AI skills news for small and medium businesses

entries.title: Anthropic Doubles Claude Code Limits, Signs SpaceX Colossus Deal for 220K+ GPUs — SMB Capacity Skyrockets
entries.summary: Claude Code five-hour rate limits are now doubled for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, and peak-hours throttling is gone. Anthropic also signed a deal for all compute at SpaceX's Colossus 1 data center (300+ megawatts, 220K+ NVIDIA GPUs). For SMB owners: this is the biggest capacity expansion in Claude's history — your Claude Code usage limits just doubled at no cost increase, and the SpaceX deal means future capacity won't be constrained. If you've been hitting rate limits building skills, retry right now.

entries.title: Anthropic Files Confidentially for IPO at $965B Valuation — $47B Annualized Revenue
entries.summary: Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft S-1 to the SEC on June 1, following a $65B Series H funding round at a $965B post-money valuation. The company now reports $47B annualized revenue. For SMB owners: an IPO means public financial disclosures, which will reveal exactly how sustainable Claude Pro/Max pricing is — and signals Anthropic is building for the long haul, reducing platform risk for businesses that rely on Claude skills.

entries.title: Claude AI Down June 2: Multi-Service Outage Hits claude.ai, API, and Claude Code — Fix Deployed
entries.summary: Claude experienced elevated error rates across claude.ai, Claude Console, API, and Claude Code starting around 2:19 AM ET on June 2. Anthropic identified the root cause and deployed a fix within hours. For SMB owners: if you build business workflows around Claude, this is a reminder to add redundancy — build your critical skills with fallback models or queue-and-retry patterns so a single-service outage doesn't halt your operations.

entries.title: OtterlyAI Launches Claude Skill + Marketplace of 101 Pre-Built Marketing Workflows for AI Search
entries.summary: OtterlyAI released a Claude Skill that brings brand visibility data (share of voice, citation gaps, GEO audits) directly into Claude chat, plus a Marketplace with 101+ tested workflows connecting to n8n, Claude, and other platforms. For SMB marketing owners: you can now ask Claude to pull your brand's AI Search performance and generate a content brief targeting the prompts where you're losing to competitors — all inside one chat without switching tools.

entries.title: Superpowers Skills Framework Hits 174K GitHub Stars, Ships as Anthropic Marketplace Plugin
entries.summary: The Superpowers framework (obra/superpowers) now has 174K GitHub stars and shipped as an official Anthropic marketplace plugin. It packages engineering discipline as 14 SKILL.md files that work across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode — no SDK, no fine-tuning. For SMB skills builders: this proves the 'skills as markdown' pattern is viable for non-code business skills too. The same approach works for building your own business CLAUDE.md files that teach Claude your company's specific processes.

entries.title: Claude for Small Business: Complete Setup Guide Walks Through All 15 Cowork Workflows
entries.summary: A comprehensive setup guide for Anthropic's Claude for Small Business plugin covers the exact setup process, all 15 workflows (payroll forecasting, cash management, month-end close, overdue invoice chasing, marketing campaigns, contract review), how to build your CLAUDE.md business brain file, and model selection (Sonnet vs Opus) for each task. For SMB owners: this is the most thorough walkthrough available — it includes copy-paste prompts for every workflow and tells you which mistakes to avoid when letting Claude touch your finances.
